title: Rachel D
content: I left my body and knew I wasn't a body anymore. The brightest light filled everywhere like a waiting room, but with just my friend in there. She had passed only three weeks or so before me in this incident. I felt the best I’d ever felt in this light, and I was so incredibly happy to see him. I was in awe of how loved and safe I felt. My friend wouldn’t show me his face because he was really upset. He was leaning over with his head in hands. He said I had to go and that I couldn’t be there with him. I begged him to stay; but he couldn’t bear to look at me and sent me away. The next minute, I woke up from my life-saving operation and thought, "I don’t want to be here."

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain, Ectopic pregnancy, Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I can sometimes reach that place of love and safety during meditation or healing, but I can never replicate the realness of it all.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: The light was something I’d never felt in my real life.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, My friend died a few weeks before this happened to me
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt love and happiness. Yet I felt annoyed that I couldn’t go further
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will, I think I had things I had to do or be present for
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I became interested in karma and reincarnation
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, I knew I had to go back
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, Divorce and lost many friends.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, It was as if there was no time, and I was about to go elsewhere but wasn’t allowed to do so.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I have learned how to heal people all over the world with my mind and certain techniques
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I believe my friend is my guide and he helps me through
